description: The file 'InvoiceWorker.java' contains utility methods for managing invoices in the OFBiz ERP framework. It includes functions to calculate invoice totals, retrieve related parties and addresses, handle tax calculations, currency conversions, and apply payments. The class provides core invoice processing logic and interacts extensively with the entity model of OFBiz.

classes.name: InvoiceWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for processing invoices, including total calculations, tax management, address retrieval, and currency conversions within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getInvoiceTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of an invoice, including taxes, given either an invoice ID or a GenericValue object. Supports conversion to system currency if specified.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemTotal
methods.description: Computes the total for an individual invoice item by multiplying quantity and unit amount.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemDescription
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for an invoice line item, resolving product or tax descriptions, images, or type descriptions.

methods.name: getTaxableInvoiceItemTypeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of invoice item types that are taxable, identified by the enumTypeId 'TAXABLE_INV_ITM_TY'.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total tax amount for an invoice based on its invoice items.

methods.name: getInvoiceUnattributedTaxTotal
methods.description: Computes total tax amount for tax invoice items that lack attribution to any specific tax authority or geo.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxAuthPartyAndGeos
methods.description: Returns a map linking each tax authority party ID to a set of geographic IDs, indicating where the invoice is taxed.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxTotalForTaxAuthPartyAndGeo
methods.description: Calculates total tax for an invoice associated with a specific tax authority party and geo ID.

methods.name: getInvoiceAddressByType
methods.description: Retrieves the address associated with an invoice based on the contactMechPurposeTypeId, such as billing or shipping address.

methods.name: getShippingAddress
methods.description: Fetches the shipping address for an invoice, first from invoice contact mechanisms and then from shipment details if necessary.

methods.name: getBillToAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the billing address associated with an invoice.

methods.name: getSendFromAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the sender's address for an invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceNotApplied
methods.description: Calculates the remaining amount of an invoice that is not yet applied to payments, supporting different currency options.

methods.name: getInvoiceApplied
methods.description: Returns the total amount of an invoice that has been applied to payments, considering date filters and currency conversions.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemApplied
methods.description: Calculates how much of an invoice item has been applied through payment applications.

methods.name: getInvoiceCurrencyConversionRate
methods.description: Determines the currency conversion rate for an invoice, considering posted transactions, payments, or dated exchange rates.

methods.name: getInvoiceCurrencyConversionRate
methods.description: Fetches the currency conversion rate for an invoice by its ID.
